PACK.notes: 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full, 10.5 V floor (cutoff V 10.5 in firmware). A pack that reads 6.8 V is dead: never charge it.

ESTOP.type: E-STOP — NC mushroom switch in the + lead
ESTOP.notes: Latching, twist-release, mounted at deck X −140 (assembly.py). Breaks EVERYTHING on the pack side; the Pi keeps running on the bank.

WAGO_P.notes: Lever nut, 24–12 AWG. Slot 1 takes the 14 AWG pigtail, the rest 22 AWG. This and its twin are the ONLY pack-side splices.

WAGO_N.notes: Every return comes back here on its own wire. Never through a board GND pin, never through a USB cable.

SHIELD_PWR.type: CNC Shield v3 — power screw terminal
SHIELD_PWR.notes: 1000 µF 25 V electrolytic across VMOT/GND at the terminal, stripe (−) to GND. Reversed = vents on first power-up.

XL4015.type: XL4015 5 A buck — trim OUT to 6.0 V
XL4015.notes: Screw terminals. Set 6.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT, then wire the PCA9685. Heatsink on. 4 A continuous derated.

LM2596.type: LM2596 3 A buck — trim OUT to 5.0 V
LM2596.notes: Screw terminals. Set 5.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT. 2 A continuous without a fan. Vin must stay ≥ 6.5 V (pack floor 10.5 V: fine).

PCA_PWR.notes: The big 2-pin terminal at the end of the board = servo rail, NOT logic VCC.

FAN.type: 40 mm 5 V fan on the driver heatsinks
FAN.notes: Must be a 5 V fan. A 12 V fan goes on the pack Wagos instead — read the label.

WAGO5_P.notes: Feeds the four sensor loads; the fan takes its own wire straight off the LM2596 OUT terminal.

WAGO5_N.notes: Power returns for the sensors. Each radar ALSO grounds to its CP2102 (signal reference): two GND wires per radar.

DIV.type: Pack-voltage divider on perfboard — 47 kΩ / 10 kΩ
DIV.notes: 47 kΩ between PACK+ and A3; 10 kΩ between A3 and GND. 12.6 V → 2.21 V at A3 (R4 ADC ref 5 V, VBAT_RATIO 57/10). A3 = the shield's CoolEn pin.

SHIELD_A3.type: CNC Shield v3 — CoolEn header pin (= R4 A3)
SHIELD_A3.notes: The 4-pin block Abort/Hold/Resume/CoolEn on the shield's edge; CoolEn is A3. Its GND is the neighbouring GND pin.

BANK.type: USB power bank 5 V / 3 A (logic island)
BANK.notes: Genuine 3 A bank. Cable ≤ 0.3 m, ≥ 24 AWG power conductors. Powers ONLY the Pi; the Pi powers the R4, the hub, the adapters and the webcam.

PI_PWR.notes: Under-voltage warning at 4.63 V. Early Pi 4 (rev 1.1) needs an A-to-C or non-e-marked cable.

R4.type: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi — under the shield (stacked, no wires)
R4.notes: Stack the shield on the R4; the pins listed are what the shield takes. Firmware r4_drive v1.0-best-drive: 30 kHz step ISR, 1/32, 415 mm/s. Logic 5 V. USB from the Pi hub; ENABLE_WIFI 0.

SHIELD_CTRL.type: CNC Shield v3 — jumpers and control pins
SHIELD_CTRL.notes: AS BUILT: caps on MS1 + MS3 under every driver = 1/32 (M0+M2), MS2 open. Two jumpers on the A header = D12/D13 drive the A axis. 10 kΩ from EN to 5V (pull-up) so the drivers stay OFF during R4 resets. Caps on before the drivers.

R_EN.notes: Consumables. Without it, D8 floats LOW during the R4's ~1 s reset and all four drivers sit at full current uncommanded.

DRV.type: DRV8825 ×4 in sockets X Y Z A (plug-in, no wires)
pinlabels: EN pin over the socket's EN label
DRV.notes: Orientation: the driver's EN pin over the socket's EN label; trimpot toward the power terminal on Pololu layouts, clones vary — go by the label. Backwards = dead driver. Set Vref with motors UNPLUGGED, meter black on the shield GND pin, red on the trimpot screw.

X_MOT.type: CNC Shield v3 — X driver motor header (BL)
X_MOT.notes: 4-pin male header beside the X socket. Driver STEP = D2, DIR = D5, EN = D8 shared. Firmware map: BL = X.

Y_MOT.type: CNC Shield v3 — Y driver motor header (FL)
Y_MOT.notes: 4-pin male header beside the Y socket. Driver STEP = D3, DIR = D6, EN = D8 shared. Firmware map: FL = Y.

Z_MOT.type: CNC Shield v3 — Z driver motor header (BR)
Z_MOT.notes: 4-pin male header beside the Z socket. Driver STEP = D4, DIR = D7, EN = D8 shared. Firmware map: BR = Z.

A_MOT.type: CNC Shield v3 — A driver motor header (FR)
A_MOT.notes: 4-pin male header beside the A socket. Driver STEP = D12, DIR = D13, EN = D8 shared. Firmware map: FR = A.

M_BL.notes: Find the pairs with the meter: the two leads that read ~1.5–2 Ω are ONE coil. Lead colours vary between batches — the meter, not the colour, decides.

M_FL.notes: Find the pairs with the meter: the two leads that read ~1.5–2 Ω are ONE coil. Lead colours vary between batches — the meter, not the colour, decides.

M_BR.notes: Find the pairs with the meter: the two leads that read ~1.5–2 Ω are ONE coil. Lead colours vary between batches — the meter, not the colour, decides.

M_FR.notes: Find the pairs with the meter: the two leads that read ~1.5–2 Ω are ONE coil. Lead colours vary between batches — the meter, not the colour, decides.

PI.notes: Physical pin numbers (odd = inner row from the SD-card end). i2c3 on BCM 4/5 needs dtoverlay=i2c3 in config.txt and has NO on-board pull-ups. w1-gpio must stay off (it defaults to BCM 4).

PCA_LOGIC.type: PCA9685 logic header (6 pins, either end)
PCA_LOGIC.notes: Adafruit-pattern silkscreen: GND OE SCL SDA VCC V+. OE left open (internal pull-down = outputs on). V+ pin unused; V+ enters at the terminal. Address 0x40 (no jumpers).

PCA_CH0.type: PCA9685 channel 0 (3-pin, at the board's channel 0 end)
PCA_CH0.notes: Rows on the board: PWM (top, yellow), V+ (middle, red), GND (bottom, black). Channels 1–15 empty.

TILT.notes: Plugs straight onto channel 0, brown toward the board edge (GND row). Limits 65–150° in turret.py.

PAN.notes: Continuous-rotation unit: cannot hold an angle. Pinned with the printed lock; leave its lead unplugged.

SHIELD_I2C.type: CNC Shield v3 — A4/A5 + 5V/GND pins (= R4 Wire bus, 5 V logic)
SHIELD_I2C.notes: A4/A5 are the R4's primary I2C ('Wire'), 5 V logic, no on-board pull-ups: the PCA9685's 10 kΩ pull-ups to VCC=5 V do the job. NOT the R4's Qwiic socket (that is Wire1, 3.3 V).

MLX.notes: On i2c3 (BCM 4/5) ALONE so it can run at 1 MHz. BCM 4/5 have no pull-ups: if the module has none either, add 4.7 kΩ SDA→3V3 and SCL→3V3. Rides beside the webcam on the tilt bracket.

TOF_F.type: VL53L1X ToF FRONT (0x29 → re-addressed 0x30 by XSHUT)
TOF_F.notes: Both ToFs share I2C-1. At boot the Pi holds FRONT XSHUT low, gives REAR 0x29… then raises FRONT and moves it to 0x30.

TOF_R.notes: XSHUT on BCM 27 so the Pi can reset it independently.

MIC.notes: L/R tied to GND = left channel. On the post front face, 120 mm up (assembly.py).

PULL.type: 2 × 4.7 kΩ i2c3 pull-ups (only if the MLX module has none)
PULL.notes: Meter the module first: SDA to GND must read ≤ 3.3 V when powered alone.

PI_USB.notes: 1.2 A shared across all four ports (peak here 0.80 A). Webcam on its own port, everything else through the hub.

CAM.notes: On the turret beside the thermal array. If it drops out at 1080p, run 720p.

R4_USB.notes: USB CDC serial to the Pi: /dev/serial/by-id/*Arduino*

CP1.notes: Only GND, TXD, RXD are used. 5V and 3V3 pins stay EMPTY (the radar is powered from the LM2596 rail, not the Pi's USB budget). Jumper on 3.3 V logic if the adapter has one. Label the adapter body: LD2410C LEFT.

CP2.notes: Only GND, TXD, RXD are used. 5V and 3V3 pins stay EMPTY (the radar is powered from the LM2596 rail, not the Pi's USB budget). Jumper on 3.3 V logic if the adapter has one. Label the adapter body: LD2410C RIGHT.

CP3.type: CP2102 USB-UART no.3 → LD2450 (when the third adapter arrives)
CP3.notes: Only GND, TXD, RXD are used. 5V and 3V3 pins stay EMPTY (the radar is powered from the LM2596 rail, not the Pi's USB budget). Jumper on 3.3 V logic if the adapter has one. Label the adapter body: LD2450 (when the third adapter arrives).

LDL.notes: Pins per Hi-Link manual table 1: 1 UART_Tx, 2 UART_Rx, 3 OUT, 4 GND, 5 VCC (5–12 V, 5 V advised). IO 3.3 V, 256000 baud. OUT unused.

LDR.notes: Pins per Hi-Link manual table 1: 1 UART_Tx, 2 UART_Rx, 3 OUT, 4 GND, 5 VCC (5–12 V, 5 V advised). IO 3.3 V, 256000 baud. OUT unused.

LD2450.notes: Silkscreen 5V GND TX RX; 5 V supply, 3.3 V UART, 256000 baud. Needs the THIRD CP2102 — until it arrives, leave power and data unplugged.

ESP3.type: ESP32-S3 DevKitC no.3 — csi_rx_udp, ON the rover at deck (60,120)
ESP3.notes: Joins the Pi hotspot (channel 6) and streams the CSI of every probe to the Pi, UDP 5005. secrets.h holds the hotspot name and password (git-ignored).

ESP2.type: ESP32-S3 DevKitC no.2 — csi_tx, OFF the rover
ESP2.notes: Dropped ~3 m along the wall. 100 Hz ESP-NOW probes on channel 6. Radio link only — no wire to the rover.
